topics.title: Zinda aur be-jaan
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Aao Student, socho agar tumharay garden mein ek khubsurat phool khilta hai aur usi bagiche mein ek pathar bhi maujood hai, tou kya tumhein pata hai ke in dono mein kya farq hai? Kya phool zinda hai aur pathar be-jaan?

## SAMJHAO
Zinda aur be-jaan cheezon ka farq samajhna bohat zaroori hai. Zinda cheezein wo hain jo khud se grow kar sakti hain, khana kha sakti hain, aur apne aap ko badal sakti hain. Jaise ke insaan, jaanwar, aur poday. In sab ki kuch khasiyat hoti hain: wo khud se khana hasil karte hain, hawa se oxygen lete hain, aur reproduce bhi karte hain.

Be-jaan cheezein wo hain jo kabhi nahi jeeti, na khati hain aur na hi grow karti hain. Jaise ke pathar, paani, aur furniture. Ye cheezain sirf ek hi halat mein rahte hain aur inmein kisi tarah ka jaan nahi hota. 

Zinda cheezein hamesha apne aas paas ke environment ke sath interact karti hain. Jab ek phool khilta hai, tou wo bees ya butterflies ko attract karta hai. Lekin pathar usi jagah rahta hai jahan wo rakha gaya ho, wo kabhi nahi hilta ya badalta.

Hamara environment bhi in dono cheezon se bhara hua hai. Jab aap bazaar jaate hain, tou aapko zinda cheezein jaise ke khudai fruits ya vegetables dikhai dete hain, jabke be-jaan cheezein jaise ke dukanon ka saman wahan bhi maujood hota hai.

## MISAAL
Socho jab aap bazaar jate hain, tou wahan bohot saari zinda aur be-jaan cheezein hoti hain. Jaise ke fresh sabziyaan, jo zinda hain, aur khokha, jo be-jaan hai. Zinda sabziyan khud se grow hoti hain, lekin khokha sirf ek structure hai jo kisi cheez ko rakhne ke liye bana hota hai.

## KARO
Ab tum ghar ya school mein ek activity karte hain. Ek zinda aur be-jaan cheezon ki list banao. Apne aas paas jo cheezein hain unmein se kuch zinda aur kuch be-jaan cheezein dhoondho. Phir unhein ek kaghaz par likho. Jaise ke tumhare ghar ke aas paas ke phool, ped, khidki, ya toy.

## SAWAAL
1. Zinda cheezein kya hoti hain? Ek misaal do.  
2. Be-jaan cheezein kis tarah ki hoti hain?  
3. Bazaar mein tumhein kaise pata chalega ke koi cheez zinda hai ya be-jaan?  

Science Sir

topics.title: Janwar ki qismein
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Aik dafa ka zikar hai ke ek chota sa chuhar (mouse) zameen par daud raha tha, jabke ek machhli paani mein tair rahi thi. Kya aapne kabhi socha hai ke in dono ke beech kya farq hai? Doston, har janwar ka apna ek khaas maqam hota hai!

## SAMJHAO
Janwaron ki qismain aam tor par teen categories mein taqseem ki jaati hain: Zameen ke janwar, paani ke janwar, aur hawa ke janwar. Zameen ke janwar woh hain jo zameen par rehne aur chalne phirne mein maharat rakhte hain. Jaise ke kutte, billi, aur gaye. Ye sab janwar zameen par chal kar khana dhoondte hain.

Paani ke janwar woh hain jo paani mein rehte hain. Jaise machhlyan, kachhue, aur chhipkلی. Ye sab janwar paani mein tair kar apna rozana ka khana hasil karte hain aur wahan ki zindagi se bhagwan ke aajaib ko jeete hain.

Hawa ke janwar, jinhain hum parindey kehte hain, aise hain jo hawa mein udte hain. Jese parindey aur tiliyan (bats). Ye jaanwar hawa mein ud kar uncha udte hain aur zameen par khana dhoondhne ke liye wapas aate hain.

Har kism ke janwar ka apna environment hota hai, aur wo wahin par sukoon se reh sakte hain. Unka har aks (behaviour) unki qism aur tawajjo se maloom hota hai.

## MISAAL
Aapko yaad hai jab aap bazaar jaate hain, to wahan aap aksar dekhtay hain ke kutte dikkat karte hain aur kis tarah se woh zameen par chalte hain. Agar aap paani ke paas jaate hain, to machhliyan aur kachhuwa aapko paani mein dikhai dete hain. Ye sab kuch humein ye samajhne mein madad dete hain ke har janwar kis tarah apne environment mein zindagi guzarta hai.

## KARO
Apne ghar ya school ke ird gird dekhein aur jaanch karain ke kitne alag alag qism ke janwar hain. Aap kuch pictures bana sakte hain ya collage kar sakte hain. Aap zameen, paani aur hawa ke janwaron ki pictures ka use karke ek poster bana sakte hain. Poster mein har ek janwar ke liye uska naam aur uska environment likhen, taake aapka poster dikhaaye ka kaise har janwar apni jagah par rehta hai.

## SAWAAL
1. Zameen ke janwaron ki kya misaalain hain? 
2. Paani ke janwar kis tarah ki jagah par rehte hain?
3. Hawa ke janwaron ka kya kaam hota hai?

Apne jawab tayar karo aur apne doston ke sath share karo! 

Science Sir.

topics.title: Podha kaise ugta hai
topics.description: Beej se podha — seed to plant
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Kya aapne kabhi chhoti si beej ko dekh kar socha hai ke ye kaise bada aur khoobsurat podha ban sakta hai? Chalo, aaj hum is naeem safar par chalte hain jahan hum beej se podhe tak ka raaz jaanenge!

## SAMJHAO
Podha ugne ka amal bahut hi dilchasp hota hai. Sab se pehle, hume ek beej ki zarurat hoti hai. Beej chhota hota hai, lekin usmein ek zinda jism hota hai. Jab beej ko paani aur khushk hawa milti hai, to wo chaand taazgi se jagta hai.

Uske baad, beej apne andar se ek chhoti si jhaari ya 'root' nikaalta hai. Ye root zameen ke andar jaata hai aur paani aur khurak ki talash karta hai. Uske saath hi, beej ke upar se ek chhoti si jhaad ya 'shoot' bahar aati hai. Is shoot mein podhe ke patte aur shakhein banti hain.

Jaise jaise din guzarte hain, ye podha bara hota jata hai aur iske patte hara rang le lete hain. Is waqt, podha photosynthesis bhi shuru kar deta hai. Ye chaand, dhoond, yaani light ko energy mein tabdeel karta hai. Aakhir mein, podha ek khubsurat phool ya phir phal (fruit) bhi de sakta hai.

Humara har din jo khana ya greeans khate hain, wo aise hi podhon ka nateeja hota hai jo beej se shuru hote hain. Har ek podha aur uske beej ka apna ek kahani hota hai.

## MISAAL
Chalo ek misaal lete hain. Pakistan mein aam, narangi ya seb ke beej ko le lo. Jab in beejon ko kisaan zameen mein lagata hai, to ye dheere dheere khubsurat phalon ke ped ban jaate hain. Taza aam ya narangi khana humein na sirf maza deta hai balki ye hamaari sehat ke liye bhi faida mand hota hai.

## KARO
Ab kuch dilchasp karte hain. Aapko sirf ek chhoti si daani ka beej lena hai, puuri zindagi ke liye ek parivar banana hai. Ghar ke kisi khali dibbe ya paudon ki gaddi mein beej lagao, paani do aur roz iski dekha rekha karna. Aap dekhenge ke wo beej kis tarah dheere dheere podha banta hai.

## SAWAAL
1. Podha beej se kaise nikaalta hai?
2. Podha apne liye khurak kaise ikattha karta hai?
3. Aam aur narangi ke beej ka example do.

Science Sir

topics.title: Khana ki qismein
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Kya aapne kabhi socha hai ke aapka favorite biryani kyun itna tasty hota hai? Ya phir cricket khelte waqt aapko zyada taqat kyun chahiye hoti hai? Aaj hum khanay ki qisemon ke baare mein jaanenge jo hamein taqat, masbooti aur immunity dete hain!

## SAMJHAO
Khana sirf bhookh mitane ke liye nahi hota, balki yeh humein alag-alag tarah se madad deta hai. Pehli qism hai Energy food. Yeh aise khanay hain jo hamein taqat dete hain, jaise ke roti, chawal, aur fruits. Jab hum yeh khane khate hain, to hamein din bhar kaam karne ki energy milti hai.

Doosri qism hai Body-building food. Yeh khanay hamari body ki masalay banate hain aur hamein strong banate hain. Ismein daalain, meat, aur eggs shamil hain. Yeh khanay humein muscles banane aur body ko mazboot rakhnay mein madad karte hain.

Teesri qism hai Protective food. Yeh khanay hamein bimariyon se bachate hain. Ismein sabziyan aur fruits hote hain, jaise ke palak, gajar, aur oranges. Yeh khanay hamari immunity ko strong karte hain taake hum healthy rah sakein.

Har qism ka khana milkar hamein ek balanced diet deta hai, jo hamein har roz zinda rehne ke liye zaroori hai. Isliye, har meal mein in tino qisemon ka khayal rakhna zaroori hai.

## MISAAL
Kya aapne bazaar mein kabhi fresh fruits dekhay hain? Jab hum mango ya oranges khate hain, to yeh humare liye Protective food hain. Aur jab hum daal aur chicken khate hain, to yeh Body-building food hain. Yeh sab khanay mil kar hamein healthy aur khush rakhte hain, jyunke cricketers ko achi performance ke liye taqat ki zaroorat hoti hai!

## KARO
Aaj aap ghar par apne maa baap ke saath milkar ek healthy meal plan banain. Ismein teen qisemon ka khana shamil karein: ek Energy food, ek Body-building food, aur ek Protective food. Dekhein ke aapke liye kaunsa khana sabse acha hoga!

## SAWAAL
1. Khana ki teen qismein kya hain? 
2. Aapko kis qism ka khana strongest banata hai?
3. Protective food ka kya faida hai?

Allah aapko sehat de! Science Sir.

topics.title: Paani ki ahmiyat
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Aaj kal agar hum kisi bhi shehray ka mood dekhain, to sab log paani ki kami ki shikayat kartay hain. Kya aap ko maloom hai ke paani sirf peene ke liye nahi, balki aur bhi kayi kaamon ke liye istemal hota hai? Sochain agar paani nahi hoga, to kya hoga?

## SAMJHAO
Paani zindagi ke liye bohot zaroori hai. Har insaan ko achi sehat ke liye din mein kam se kam 8 glass paani peena chahiye. Is ke ilawa, paani sirf insaano ke liye nahi, balki jaanwaro aur podon ke liye bhi zaroori hai. Paani ka istemal karte waqt humein iski ahmiyat samajhni chahiye taake hum isay bacha sakein.

Bachon, hum ghar mein ya bahar kahan kahan paani istemal karte hain? Jab hum daant brush karte hain, jab hum khana banate hain, ya jab hum nahate hain, tab paani ka istemal hota hai. Paani se hi humare baagh-bagiche khilte hain aur jaanwaron ko paani dete hain. Aapne kabhi dekha hai ke ek khubsurat phool ya ped kis tarah se paani se bharpur hota hai?

Lekin, humein yaad rakhna chahiye ke paani ko bachaana bhi hamesha hamari zimmedaari hai. Agar hum zyada paani wastage karte hain to is se sab ko mushkil hoti hai. Kya aapne kabhi apne ghar mein dekha hai ke hum kaise paani ki bachat kar sakte hain?

Isliye paani ki ahmiyat ko samajhna bohot zaroori hai. Hum sab ko paani ki bachat karne ki koshish karni chahiye takay aane wale log bhi isay istemal kar sakein.

## MISAAL
Chalo, ek misaal lete hain. Jab hum Islamabad ke bazar mein jaate hain toh wahan ka pani kaise zindagi chalayata hai? Jo dukan walay hain, unhe paani ki zaroorat hoti hai khana banane ke liye. Agar bazar mein paani nahi hoga, to sabziyan kaise bechi jaengi? Biryani banane waale ko bhi paani chahiye hota hai. Is tarah, paani bazar ki zindagi ka ek aham hissa hai.

## KARO
Ab aap sab ek activity karenge. Apne ghar ke bathroom ya kitchen mein dekhein aur note karein ke aap kitna paani istemal karte hain. Phir sochain ke aap paani ki bachat kaise kar sakte hain. Kya aap tap khula rakh ke nahi nahate? Kya aap daant brush karte waqt tap ko band kar sakte hain? Isay ek paper par likhein aur next week apne doston ke sath share karein!

## SAWAAL
1. Paani ki ahmiyat kya hai aur yeh kahan kahan istemal hota hai?
2. Aap paani ki bachat kaise kar sakte hain?
3. Bazaar mein paani istemal karne ka kya faida hai?

Science Sir

topics.title: Pakistan ke seasons
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Kya aap ne kabhi soche hai ke hamare Pakistan mein mawaqif kaisay tabdeel hote hain? Jab garmi ka mausam hota hai, to kya aapko uski mehsoosi pata hai? Aayiye, hum garmi, sardi, barsat aur bahar ke baray mein jaante hain!

## SAMJHAO
Pakistan mein chaar mukhtalif seasons hain. Pehla mausam garmi hai, jo aksar April se shuru hote hue, August tak chalta hai. Is waqt dhoond kaamzori hoti hai aur hum sabko thandi cheezon ki zarurat mehsoos hoti hai. Garmi ke dinon mein hum lemonade ya mango shake ka maza lete hain.

Dusra mausam sardi hai. Sardi ka mausam November se shuru hota hai aur February tak rehta hai. Is waqt halki si barf bhi gir sakti hai, khaaskar northern areas mein. Is mausam mein hum sweaters aur jackets pehente hain kyunki bahar nikalte waqt kaafi thand hoti hai.

Teesra mausam barsat hai, jo aksar July se September tak hota hai. Barsat ke dinon mein khushbu se bhari hawa hoti hai. Yeh mausam zyada ter kisano ke liye khaas hota hai kyunki is waqt kheton mein paani milta hai aur kheti achi hoti hai.

Choutha mausam bahar hai, jo ke February se shuru hota hai aur April tak rehta hai. Is waqt phool khilte hain aur har taraf khushbuein fail jaati hain. Bahar ka mausam hamesha dilchasp hota hai, kyunki is mein sab kuch naya hota hai!

## MISAAL
Agar aap bazaar jayein to garmi mein aapko zyada thandi drink ya ice-cream milegi. Sardi ke dauran, log garam halwa ya peanut chaat khana pasand karte hain. Barsaat ke dinon mein, aapko umbrella aur raincoat dekhne ko milenge, jab log pani mein ghar se bahar nikalte hain. Bahar ke mausam mein, aap phoolon ki dukanon mein bahut rang birange phool dekh sakte hain.

## KARO
Apne ghar ke aas paas dekhein aur har mausam ka mehsoos karne ki koshish karein. Garmi ke dinon mein thandi cheezein khayen, sardi mein garam kapre pehenein, barsat mein barsaat ka maza lein, aur bahar ke mauke par phoolon ko dekhein. Phir ek notebook mein likhein ke aapne har mausam mein kya mehsoos kiya.
